name: Burning Building OLD
disable: DC 19 Survival to beat the flames with a stage curtain or similar cloth, DC 14 Acrobatics to splash liquids onto the fire, or 5 points of cold damage.

generalAbilities.name: Conflagration
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature starts its turn in a burning building

Effect The creature must attempt a DC 18 Reflex Saving Throw save or take 1d6 Fire Damage damage

generalAbilities.name: Spread
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The round ends and no creature has attempted to Disable it this round

Effect A building within 15 feet becomes a burning building. The burning building can't use Spread next round.
